causal_candidate.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
  (define (neighbors p seen)
    (filter (lambda (q)
      (and (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) (rows g) (cols g))
           (not (= (at g (first q) (second q)) 5))
           (not (member? q seen))))
      (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) dirs)))
  (define (search start)
    (let bfs ((queue (list (list start (list start)))) (seen (list start)) (done (list)))
      (if (empty? queue) done
        (let* ((item (first queue)) (p (first item)) (path (second item)) (ns (neighbors p seen)))
          (bfs (append (rest queue) (map (lambda (q) (list q (cons q path))) ns))
               (append seen ns) (cons item done))))))
  (define color (first (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c 5)) (= (length (find-color g c)) 2))) (grid-colors g 0))))
  (define endpoints (find-color g color))
  (define first-search (search (first endpoints)))
  (define max-length (apply max (map (lambda (item) (length (second item))) first-search)))
  (define farthest (first (sort (map first (filter (lambda (item) (= (length (second item)) max-length)) first-search)) cell<)))
  (define first-path (second (first (filter (lambda (item) (equal? (first item) farthest)) first-search))))
  (define second-path (second (first (filter (lambda (item) (equal? (first item) (second endpoints))) (search farthest)))))
  (for/fold ((out g)) ((p (in-list (append first-path second-path))))
    (set-cell out (first p) (second p) color))))
